headline: Probability measures likelihood—the math of how often things happen given what's possible
universal_truth: Not everything is equally likely; understanding odds helps you bet wisely on life
fun_facts: You're more likely to be struck by lightning than win a major lottery jackpot
The probability of flipping 10 heads in a row is about 1 in 1,000
Humans are notoriously bad at intuiting probability—we consistently misjudge odds
discussion_questions: What odds are you playing in your current decisions?
Where do you overestimate or underestimate probability?
How would better probability intuition change your choices?

hook.script: Will it rain? Will you get the job? Will this investment pay off? Life is filled with uncertainty—but not all outcomes are equally likely. Probability measures how often things happen given what's possible. It's the math of betting on the future.

cliff.script: We make probability judgments constantly, usually poorly. Why is understanding probability so important?

options.text: Probability calibrates expectations to reality—understanding odds helps you bet on likely outcomes, avoid unlikely traps, and make decisions that work over time
options.response: Yes. Life is about playing odds. Good probability intuition means making choices that work out more often than not. It's not about certainty—it's about playing the numbers wisely.
It does predict random events, but applies more broadly to any uncertain outcome...

fact1.title: Base Rates Matter
fact1.script: How likely something is starts with how often it happens normally—the base rate. Before asking 'could this happen to me?', ask 'how often does this happen at all?' Base rates anchor probability.

fact2.title: Human Bias
fact2.script: We're bad at probability. We overweight dramatic events, underweight common ones. We think rare things are common if we've seen them recently. Knowing your biases improves your odds.

fact3.title: Playing the Odds
fact3.script: Good decisions play favorable odds repeatedly. You'll still lose sometimes, but probability favors you over time. Make choices with good odds, accept individual losses, trust the numbers.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Not everything is equally likely. Understanding odds helps you bet wisely on life. Learn to play probability.

outro.script: That's Day 301. Tomorrow, we'll explore finding patterns in numbers—statistics. Until then, consider the odds you're playing in your current decisions.

growTrack.title: Odds Assessment - What Are You Betting On?
growTrack.activity: Pick a decision you're facing. What's the probability of different outcomes? Are you overestimating unlikely scenarios or underestimating likely ones? How do the actual odds compare to your gut feeling?
